offer.title: Accept the public offer
offer.intro: Before you request a pilot or contact sales, confirm you accept the public offer for BidShard self-hosted software.
points: License runs on your VPS or dedicated server; vendor does not host your traffic.

empathy.title: If this feels like your week

empathy_cards.title: Cloud tracker, cloud risk
empathy_cards.body: Your campaigns live in someone else's account. Policy bans and surprise limits land on the worst day of the month. Self-hosted keeps funnels and visitor logs on your server — we ship software, not a shared database.

empathy_cards.title: Another cloaker invoice, ROI already red
empathy_cards.body: Tracker $99, cloaker $499, IVT "next quarter" — while junk traffic still burns budget tonight. One license covers routing, cloaking, antifraud, and reporting.

empathy_cards.title: "Where did 15 conversions go?"
empathy_cards.body: Network shows 100 leads, partner shows 85, support sends screenshots. Postback trail logs every hop so you see whether the gap is network, tracker, or affiliate — before the week closes red.

empathy_cards.title: Friday night, VPS is down
empathy_cards.body: Campaigns still spin in the ad manager while ingest is dead. Lost your server? Message us on Telegram — we reissue the license key so you can bring traffic back online.

margin_guard.title: Anti-bleed while you sleep
margin_guard.body: Facebook caught bot traffic at 3 a.m. and burned $2k before you woke up? Margin Guard watches ROI on a timer and pauses your ads in Meta and Google through their APIs — plus routing in the tracker — before the day ends deep red.
margin_guard.footnote: Set your margin rules once. Margin Guard runs on Pro, Scale, and the 10-day Pilot.

killers.title: Drop the cloaker bill
killers.body: Built-in cloaking on your server — no $300–600/month third-party cloaker. Same protection on accepted traffic, more margin left after media spend.

killers.title: Bots see OK — budget stays intact
killers.body: Junk traffic gets a clean accept response while your campaign budget stays intact. Reviewers and bots see a normal page; you see every filtered hit in analytics.

killers.title: Where did 15 conversions go?
killers.body: Network says 100 leads, partner shows 85. Every postback hop is logged so you spot the gap — network, tracker, or affiliate — before the week closes in the red.

killers.title: Anti-bleed while you sleep
killers.body: Facebook burned $2k on bot traffic before you woke up? Margin Guard pauses your ads in Meta and Google through their APIs when ROI drops — not just a Telegram alert at 2 a.m.

killers.title: Conversions networks can optimize on
killers.body: Meta, Google, and TikTok conversion APIs on your server — real postback signal to the ad stack, not a half-synced browser pixel.

killers.title: Partner shave? Send proof, not screenshots
killers.body: Export clicks, postback receipts, and payout snapshots in one bundle — built for traffic refund disputes, not ticket ping-pong.

killers.title: Change servers without losing revenue days
killers.body: Move ingest to new hardware under the same license — no week-long reinstall freeze while campaigns sit idle.
